documents.subject: Payroll record and settlement clarification
documents.body:
Hello Casey and Taylor,

For the 2026-03-31 payroll record PAY-015, the packet lists gross payroll of $438,000.00, withholding of $87,600.00, employer costs of $35,040.00, and net payroll of $350,400.00. Please confirm whether any external movement associated with this record has been confirmed, or whether the amounts remain proposals for review. The settlement policy states that only confirmed external movements are settled; proposals are not settlements. Please provide any missing explanation needed for reconciliation. No additional approval or payment is established here.

documents.body:
Casey: I am reviewing PAY-015 dated 2026-03-31. The recorded gross is $438,000.00, with $87,600.00 withheld and $35,040.00 listed as employer costs. Net payroll is $350,400.00.

documents.subject: Settlement policy excerpt
documents.body: Excerpt applicable to the 2026-03-31 review: “Only confirmed external movements are settled; proposals are not settlements.” This language should be read together with payroll record PAY-015 and company identifier MERIDIAN-001. The packet supplies payroll figures but does not establish an external movement, approval, payment, or additional commercial term. Missing explanations should be requested from the appropriate internal owner before reconciliation status is characterized.

documents.subject: Follow-up actions for payroll review
documents.body: Follow-up for the 2026-03-31 payroll review: retain PAY-015 as the referenced record, verify the listed gross, withholding, employer, and net figures against available support, and request an explanation for any missing settlement detail.
